rubrics.justification: Accurately describes a high-grade expanded blastocyst with compact ICM, cohesive TE, and thinning zona; minor uncertainty around calling it 3AA vs 4AA and some image-based details are somewhat inferential.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior IVF outcomes, BMI, semen parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
Final assessment is mostly logical, but the response contains internal inconsistency in implantation estimates and some meandering/contradictory discussion before settling on a range.

Generally consistent with IVF practice: recognizes morphology limits, supports single embryo transfer, cautious use of PGT-A, and notes fresh-vs-freeze considerations; minor overreach/speculation on progesterone/OHSS without supporting data.

Provides practical recommendations for proceeding with single embryo transfer, luteal support, follow-up, and future planning including embryo banking and weight optimization, though some suggestions remain somewhat general.
